title: Problem: What reasons could justify changing the restraint rule?
shortTitle: Problem: What reasons could justify changing the restraint rule?
summary: The assigned questions test which reasons and facts could support a change in safety policy.
notes: The casebook asks whether NHTSA could justify rescission through its assessment of unreasonable risk, individual choice, equity between people who already wear belts and those who do not, or innovation. It asks what facts would matter for each rationale. A study response should identify the Safety Act’s text, explain whether each consideration belongs within its discretion, and connect evidence to the proposed choice while addressing retained alternatives. It does not present an instructor-approved answer.
